✨ cleantake | Python
🎯 Primary Use Case: Restoring corrupted or lost audio segments in dialogue recordings by leveraging backup microphone tracks.
✨ Key Features: • Recovers damaged dialogue from simultaneous recordings • Aligns main microphone with backup recordings • Compares suggested repairs • Tracks source of every replacement • Desktop app for Mac, Windows, and Linux
📖 Summary: CleanTake is a free, open-source desktop application for Mac, Windows, and Linux that recovers damaged dialogue by aligning and comparing simultaneous backup recordings with a primary microphone. It allows users to select replacement audio segments, ensuring transparency by tracking the source of every repair.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source

🔥 CalClock | C++
🎯 Primary Use Case: Desktop customization with highly configurable floating clocks and calendars on Windows.
✨ Key Features: • Multiple independently configurable floating widgets (clocks, calendars) • Customizable appearance (fonts, colors, opacity, borders) • Support for various time zones and time offsets • Alarm functionality with local commands and script calls • NTP synchronization for accurate time
📖 Summary: CalClock is a native Windows application that allows users to create and customize multiple floating analog and digital clocks, calendars, and combined panels on their desktop. It offers extensive configuration options for appearance, time zones, alarms, and synchronization, running unobtrusively from the system tray.
🔗 Links: • View Project ================ 🔓 Open Source

🌟 prune | JavaScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: To provide a comprehensive and thorough uninstallation experience for Windows applications, while also offering additional system cleanup and health monitoring tools.
✨ Key Features: • Advanced uninstallation by removing leftover files and registry keys • Quarantine system for recoverable removal of leftovers
📖 Summary: Prune is a Windows uninstaller that goes beyond the standard removal process by also identifying and quarantining leftover files, registry keys, and scheduled tasks. It consolidates multiple system management tools into one application, offering features like disk visualization, cache cleaning, and SSD health monitoring without collecting user telemetry.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source

🚀 Lufus | Python
🎯 Primary Use Case: Creating bootable USB drives and performing drive imaging/formatting on Linux systems.
✨ Key Features: • Drive imaging • Drive formatting • Bootable media creation • Python-based utility • Linux-focused
📖 Summary: Lufus is a Python-based utility for Linux systems designed for creating bootable USB drives and performing drive imaging and formatting. Inspired by Rufus, it aims to provide a user-friendly and comprehensive tool for managing bootable media and system images on Linux.
🔗 Links: • View Project ================ 🔓 Open Source

🌟 Proxima | JavaScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: To provide a unified interface for developers to access and utilize multiple AI language models within their preferred coding environments without direct API key management.
✨ Key Features: • Connects multiple AI models (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity) to coding tools
📖 Summary: Proxima is a multi-AI model connection server that integrates various large language models (like ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Perplexity) into coding tools such as Cursor and VS Code. It enables users to leverage these AI models through free browser login sessions or local providers, featuring a self-healing Python agent, multi-agent delegation, and cross-session memory.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source

🚀 jmeter | Java
🎯 Primary Use Case: Load and performance testing of web applications and other services.
✨ Key Features: • Performance and load testing for web applications, SOAP/REST, FTP, JDBC, LDAP, JMS, Mail, and more • Fully featured Test IDE for recording, building, and debugging test plans • Command-line mode for non-GUI testing on any Java-compatible OS • Dynamic HTML reporting and live reporting to third-party databases • Easy correlation for extracting data from HTML, JSON, XML, and text formats
📖 Summary: Apache JMeter is an open-source Java application designed for performance and load testing of various services. It simulates heavy loads to analyze application strength and performance under different conditions.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source
